claims.content: To allow the Auctioneer to analyze inventory performance and aging.

goal.raw_text: To allow the Auctioneer to analyze inventory performance and aging.

claims.content: The Auctioneer must be logged into the Auction Administration application.
The Auctioneer must have navigated to the 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report' section within the Reports module.
Inventory data must exist in the system for the report to generate meaningful results.
The Auctioneer navigates to the 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report' section within the Reports module of the Auction Administration application.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer navigates to the 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report' section within the Reports module of the Auction Administration application.

claims.content: The Auctioneer views the 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report' page, which includes various filtering options such as Retail Category, Gemstone, Material Purity, Product Group, Brand, Inventory Age (e.g., '0-30 days', '31-60 days'), and Retail Status.
The Auctioneer selects desired filter criteria from the available dropdowns and checkboxes to narrow down the inventory data.
The Auctioneer clicks the 'Generate Report' button.

The system generates and displays a report listing items that match the selected criteria. The report includes columns for Item Number, Description, Cost, Current Bid, Reserve Price, Time Remaining, and Age Group.
The Auctioneer reviews the generated report to analyze inventory performance and identify aging stock.
